verseText: ...for all have sinned and fall short of the glory of God...
meaning: God is gloriously sinless and perfect. All human beings have sinned – we miss the mark of perfect obedience.

recall.question: Sin means disobeying God. Who does this verse say has sinned?

meaning.question: What does it mean that we “fall short of the glory of God”?
choices: We do not live up to God’s perfect goodness
We are not important to God

application.prompt: It can be hard to admit when you have done something wrong. This verse reminds us that we all all have sinned. But thankfully, Jesus came to save sinners like you and me. What could you honestly tell God today and ask Him to forgive?
